devices:
  - name: zigbee
    groups:
      - paths:
          - path: /dev/serial/by-id/usb-Texas_Instruments_XDS110__03.00.00.20__Embed_with_CMSIS-DAP_L1100C4M-if00
  - name: zwave
    groups:
      - paths:
          - path: /dev/serial/by-id/usb-0658_0200-if00
  - name: tun
    groups:
      - paths:
          - path: /dev/net/tun

access_by_lua_block {
  local apiKey = ngx.var.authHeader1
  if apiKey ~= nil then
    local args = ngx.req.get_uri_args()
    args.token = apiKey
    ngx.req.set_uri_args(args)
  end
}

add_header Content-Type application/javascript;
return 200 "self.addEventListener('install', event => { event.waitUntil(self.skipWaiting()) })";

#!/bin/sh
response="$(
  wget -q -O - \
    --no-check-certificate \
    --header 'X-Forwarded-Proto: https' \
    --header "Api-Secret: $(echo -n "$API_SECRET" | sha1sum | cut -d' ' -f1)" \
    "https://localhost:$PORT/api/v2/status" \
)"
if ! echo "$response" | grep -Fq 'STATUS OK'; then
  echo "$response"
  exit 1
fi

set -eux
/entrypoint.sh db createdb
/entrypoint.sh db migrate
exec /entrypoint.sh run

modules:
  wiim:
    http_client_config:
      tls_config:
        insecure_skip_verify: true

    metrics:
      - name: cpu_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .temperature_cpu }"
        help: CPU temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: cpu
      - name: tmp102_temp_celsius
        valuetype: gauge
        path: "{ .temperature_tmp102 }"
        help: TMP102 temperature in Celsius
        labels:
          sensor: tmp102
